pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. denominator_integrity.rule: Both arms must use the same authoritative Experience/operational classification, accepted-receipt semantics, malformed-record handling, missing-identity handling, strict literal-bool handling for every inherited/current control boolean, N/R terminal-state semantics, authority/freshness provenance, verification-stage binding and replay-resistant evidence lineage. Candidate-only self-test timing is observational and cannot establish a speed multiplier.
denominator_integrity.reject: No positive speed claim from awake/window/commit/heartbeat/poll/retry proxies, caller-minted operational progress, receipt-less verified credit, malformed/missing-ID row censoring, truthiness-coerced control flags, replay inflation, unequal routing semantics, or excluding candidate failures/rejects from intention-to-treat coverage.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report accepted verified receipts, accepted operational evidence, duplicate/reject/malformed/missing-ID outcomes, strict-bool rejects, N/R safety outcomes, defer/timeout, verified closures, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under identical failure/censoring semantics.
